events.author: Dale Kent
events.name: ALLIANCE VICTORY!

options.text: Show me how this came to pass.
Show me how history will remember these times.

events.text: Your ally [rival] has achieved supremacy at last, and you feel proud that you contributed to the winning side. Your triumphant Alliance Player will be remembered for centuries to come.

events.text: With the fulfilment of your ambitions, you and your family leave an ever-lasting legacy on history. events.author: Dale Kent
events.name: CONQUEST VICTORY!

options.text: Show me how this came to pass.
Show me how history will remember these times.
I am not done with my story.
My work here is done.

events.text: You look out over the banners of your assembled army. Thousands of proud [rival] faces look up at you. No one remains who opposes you. No one is left to fight. It is time for you and your army to return home... as Heroes of the Old World. Congratulations, you have won a Conquest by destroying all of your opponents.

events.text: Your cities are known and admired the World over. People look in awe upon the wonders you have built. The [rival] armies have won battle after battle against our foes. events.text: As a feeling of change passes over the world, the great philosophers of our time hold a conclave in the [rival] capital. Congratulations, you have won a Time by having the most Victory Points at the end of the game.

events.name: VICTORY!

options.text: Show me how this came to pass.
Show me how history will remember these times.
I am not done with my story.
My work here is done.

events.text: All through the known world, from bustling cities to small farms, [rival] is known as the greatest of all nations. The [rival] people have explored, invented, built, fought, and so risen as the greatest nation of the Old World. Congratulations, you have won a Victory by surpassing all other nations.
